title: A signed-in person creates their publishing account from a Papyrus site
description:
Feature: Account creation from a registered Papyrus site
  Scenario: First sign-in with no account
    Given a person signed in with Google on a registered Papyrus site and belongs to no account entitled to that site
    When they create a publishing account from the site
    Then Prospectus makes them its owner, entitles it to that site's product only, and the site selects it as the tenant

Prospectus API used: POST /v1/accounts with the person's access token and an Idempotency-Key UUID (accounts/durable-accounts.ts create). No Prospectus change was needed. There is no admin or seed path by design: operator access is read-only and an account is entitled only to the calling product, so Prospectus's own console cannot create a Papyrus-entitled account. Account id is a deterministic hash of the person id, product and request key; Papyrus uses the lowercased id as the tenant id. Papyrus: route PR 331 and account-menu UI PR 330, both merged to develop 2026-10-18; waits on release and site deploys.
